name: Standard (lime green, butterfly)
description: White upper fuselage over a lime-green belly that starts behind the nose gear, runs under the cabin and sweeps up behind the rear door into an all-green fin. A butterfly of four heart-shaped petals (two sky blue, two plum) on the fin; 'jinair.com' above the forward windows in squared extended lettering, 'jin' and '.com' plum, 'air' sky blue; lime-green engines and winglets.

logos.description: Jin Air's 'nabi' butterfly: four heart-shaped petals meeting at a point, the two forward ones sky blue (large above, small below), the two aft ones plum (large above, small below).
The butterfly small at the front of the cowl, before the engine 'jinair.com'.
The butterfly low on the outer face of the green winglet.
A small Taegukgi at the fin tip.

titles.style: The Jin Air wordmark: squared, extended, even-stroke lettering, 'jinair' in letters all of capital height (painted as JINAIR), '.com' in lowercase 0.63 of them; 'jin' in plum.
The wordmark small along the green cowl ('air' sky blue).

notes: Drawn from 737 MAX 8 HL8353 (2026-06-04) and 737-800 HL8013 (2026-02-15), both left side; the right side wasn't checked, so the butterfly is assumed to read the same way on both sides (mirror false) and the fin isn't mirrored-checked. The dorsal fillet ahead of the fin stays white. Jin Air is Korean Air's low-cost subsidiary and is to absorb Air Busan and Air Seoul into one LCC (planned with the Korean Air-Asiana integration); its 777-200ERs wear the same scheme. Year of introduction taken as the airline's 2008 launch (not checked). Re-checked 2026-11-15 on HL8353 (737 MAX 8, left, 2026-06-04) and the B738 measured shape: the wordmark's 'jinair' is lettered at capital height throughout (no ascenders or dots), so the title's text is JINAIR.com with '.com' in lowercase at 0.63 of the capitals; its place over the windows, height and length agree with the photo; the lime belly's line is straight between its corners.
history: New entry (Skyarium v1 had no Jin Air). The scheme since the airline's 2008 launch.
